summary: Clearway Energy filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $100 million of Class C common stock, replacing a prior ATM program with ~$75 million unsold. Sales will occur through Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley, BofA, Citigroup, and J.P. Morgan as agents at prevailing market prices; agents earn up to 1.5% gross fee. This is a routine equity shelf takedown/ATM program, not a special situation, so no special-situation category applies. The filing discloses no merger, acquisition, tender, spin-off, or strategic review; it merely establishes a continuous equity distribution facility. The listing remains NYSE: CWEN, last price $31.18 on August 5, 2026. The program terminates on full sale or agreement termination. What to watch: potential dilution from ATM sales and any future use of proceeds, but no risk-arb angle exists.
